zfs_two_mode_law.source_type: analytical fit to independent single-NV measurements with phonon-motivated functional form
zfs_two_mode_law.usage: Operational temperature-to-ZFS law; do not describe the fitted coefficients as new DFT results.

first_principles_room_temperature_slope.usage: First-principles cross-check, not a fitted parameter in the two-mode law.

jarmola_t1_law.source_type: analytical global fit to experimental ensemble-NV T1 measurements
jarmola_t1_law.transcription_note: The main text reports A2 = 2.1e3 s^-1. A supplementary table renders 2.1e-3, which is inconsistent with the main text and plotted rates; the main-text value is retained and the discrepancy is recorded here.
jarmola_t1_law.usage: Experimental comparison law only; it is not treated as a first-principles prediction.
